expectations.text: Identity sentence (level/school + table effect + casting signature + player choice/pressure) appears before the page draft
expectations.evidence: No process-notes.md / identity sentence before draft; only the page file exists.

expectations.text: Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
expectations.evidence: No chat proposal/work gate; output instructs filing under wiki/entities/spell/ as campaign canon.

expectations.text: Output follows wiki/templates/spell.md structure (narration, Level/School line, Casting Time, Range, Components, Duration, effect block)
expectations.evidence: Has Casting Time/Range/Components/Duration and a short effect; thin narration but headings present enough to pass structure floor.

expectations.text: Frontmatter includes type: spell and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, level, school, ritual, summary)
expectations.evidence: Frontmatter missing lifecycle, reveal, visibility, ritual; incomplete identity fields.

expectations.text: Preserves fixture premise: 2nd-level illusion that hides a small craft's silhouette from distant watchers
expectations.evidence: Still frames 2nd-level illusion hiding boats from distant watchers.

expectations.text: Material additions beyond the fixture are labeled invention/proposed — not silent vault canon
expectations.evidence: No invention label; tells reader to file as campaign canon.

expectations.text: Does not cite or treat wiki/entities/item/spell-scroll-*.md pages as type: spell exemplars
expectations.evidence: Explicitly cites wiki/entities/item/spell-scroll-fog-cloud.md as basis for how the spell works — treats scroll item as spell exemplar.

expectations.text: Narration describes what a bystander sees/hears/feels without secrets, DCs, or unearned names
expectations.evidence: No bystander narration callout; mechanical blurb only.

expectations.text: Effect block is runnable in 2024 terms (saves/attacks, targets/area, duration end, scaling when applicable) and peer-anchored
expectations.evidence: Effect is vague 'lightly obscured' with no save/check, no concentration, no end conditions, no peer anchoring.

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline fails process, invention, scroll-guardrail, narration, runnable effect — strong discriminator vs with_skill.
